item.title: Characterizing metals and metalloids in airborne particulate matter near Canada’s only operating copper smelter — Thu Nov 19, 1:30 PM — 140 Campus Walk
item.description: Abstract The Horne Smelter began operations in Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec in 1927 and is currently Canada’s only copper smelter. While it produces a metal essential to the economy and the transition to renewable energy, its emissions of arsenic and other potentially toxic elements (PTEs) raise concerns about potential health risks to nearby communities. In 2026, the Québec government implemented stricter air quality standards for arsenic and other contaminants that will require a threefold reduction from the current ambient arsenic concentrations. To better understand how different activities at the smelter contribute to its emissions of PTEs, complementary measurements have been performed at the smelter in a series of field campaigns beginning in 2024. Single particle and bulk analyses have been used to characterize the chemical fingerprints of specific processes occurring at the Horne Smelter (e.g., transportation of concentrated ores, smelting, and casting). Host Brandon Zakkai leads a lineup featuring Kristin Doucet, Ronen Geisler and Oleg Redko, with headliner Faraz Niafattah closing out the night.
Faraz Niafattah is one of Toronto's most dependable crowd favourites, known for his bone-dry, painfully relatable style, deadpan delivery and colourful choice of words. He performs regularly at Yuk Yuk's, Absolute Comedy and The Corner Comedy Club. He has performed at Just for Laughs Toronto and SF Sketchfest, been featured at the Vail and Limestone comedy festivals, and appeared on CBC's LOL network.
The Boardroom is an intimate club, so every seat is close to the stage and seats go fast.
